title: Board of Water and Power Commissioners report relative to the Memorandum of Agreement between Department of Water and Power and the Board of Public Works,…
text:
[Council File 21-1188-S15]
Board of Water and Power Commissioners report relative to the Memorandum of Agreement between Department of Water and Power and the Board of Public Works, on behalf of the Bureau of Sanitation, for the cost-sharing of planning activities related to the Hyperion Water Reclamation Plant Program Implementation Plan for Pure Water Los Angeles.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: City Council approves Memorandum of Agreement between DWP and Bureau of Sanitation for cost-sharing of planning activities for the Hyperion Water Reclamation Plant Program Implementation Plan.

outcome.text: Energy and Environment Committee approved item(s) (Aug 4, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Aug 21, 2026); Council action final
